_comment: Pinned snapshot digests (the assumeutxo parameters). A consumer accepts a snapshot only if the Bend-computed state digest equals the digest pinned here for that (height, hash). The 3,522,460 entry is the last Zebra checkpoint: fill in 'digest' with the value confirm.py prints when the GENESIS instance (fullnode/state) commits exactly that height (it does: sync.py ends a window at the last checkpoint and drains before its first fully validated window). Until then it is null and no snapshot at that height is accepted.

main.source: to be produced from the genesis instance (fullnode/state) at the last checkpoint
